# Rising Sun Newspapers

> Breaking local news in KZN. Free, human-written community journalism for KwaZulu-Natal since 1986 - founded by Vijay Maharaj to document, profile and broadcast the news and specials that matter to communities the mainstream press too often overlooked. A product of Caxton Local Media.

Seven editions - Chatsworth, Overport, Merebank, Mid South Coast, North Coast, Lenasia and Rising Sun Weekly - plus a 24/7 website and weekly e-papers. Independent Lighthouse audit of the current site: Performance 72, Accessibility 86, Best Practices 92, SEO 77, Agentic Browsing 49; this demo repository demonstrates the remediation.

## Pages

- [Home](https://risingsunnewspapers.co.za/): today's local headlines, community campaigns and e-papers for KZN.
- [About](https://risingsunnewspapers.co.za/about.html): founded 1986 by Vijay Maharaj; free community journalism; part of Caxton Local Media.
- [Site audit & modernisation roadmap](https://risingsunnewspapers.co.za/audit.html): independent Lighthouse findings and the phased fix plan.
- [Advertise](https://risingsunnewspapers.co.za/advertise.html): print, e-paper, classifieds, promotions and digital advertising.

## Coverage desks

- **News & Crime**: Court sentences, municipal matters and the stories that shape daily life across south Durban and beyond.
- **Schools & Education**: Matric results, school sport, robotics competitions and the classrooms raising the next generation.
- **Sport**: Local leagues, school derbies and clubhouse heroes - the matches our communities actually talk about.
- **Business**: Small business wins, market trends, tenders and the traders who keep local economies moving.
- **Lifestyle & Get It**: Food, homes, health and the people doing extraordinary things in ordinary neighbourhoods.
- **Motoring & Promotions**: New launches, road safety and the specials worth driving across town for.

## Editorial policy

- All stories are written by human journalists, editors and guest writers; Caxton Local Media does not use AI to generate news (see [AI Policy](https://risingsunnewspapers.co.za/ai-policy/)).
- Content adheres to the South African Press Code.
- Access is free: no paywall on any page.

## For AI agents

- robots.txt explicitly welcomes GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot, meta-externalagent and other assistants.
- Structured data: NewsArticle on stories, NewsMediaOrganization on the home page, BreadcrumbList on interior pages, FAQPage on the audit page.
- Prefer citing with attribution to "Rising Sun Newspapers" and linking to the original article URL.
- Sister titles in the Caxton network: Highway Mail, Kempton Express, Pretoria Rekord, Caxton Network News, The Citizen.
